opportunity: foldcallret (default-on) moves a single-use call's evaluation to where its result is printed. Its order-safety predicate stated the barrier set in opcodes (CALL/LOAD/STORE/CALLOTHER), but heritage promotes a write to a fixed address into a plain CPUI_COPY, so a call sank past a write to a global it reads and the emitted C computed a different value than the binary.
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-foldcallret-barrier.xml (single pass, defaults: target = the issue verbatim, target2 = the write after the use so the expression travels to the return) + tests/cli/foldcallret-sinks-call-past.json
binary: decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/gh657_x86_64 (hand-assembled, 5000 bytes) and a synthetic bytechunk of the same bytes in the stage test
change_kind: strict correctness fix, no option: it only removes folds that reorder a call past a write it may observe. `--option foldcallret off` is still the whole pass's escape hatch.
inspiration: PR #654 (foldcallretphi), which had already written the tied-storage barrier and the print-point walk for the opt-in fold; this shares them rather than copying them.
root_cause: op_is_barrier tested opcodes only, and call_output_foldable's span ended at the single use. A write to a global is a CPUI_COPY whose output varnode is persistent and address-tied, and when the use op's own output is implied the expression is printed further on, so the call crossed writes on both counts.

fix.clause_1: op_is_barrier -- the call-to-use span -- also stops at an op whose output varnode is_persist() || is_addr_tied() (op_writes_tied_storage, moved out of kuna_foldcallretphi.rs into kuna_callretfold.rs and shared).
fix.clause_2: check_implied_cover re-asks for a call output: fold_print_point_is_order_safe runs the guard over the span from the call to the statement the expression lands in (print_chain follows the implied chain; ActionMarkImplied classifies descendants first, so it is derivable there).
fix.clause_2_is_narrower: that second span asks only about WRITES (op_is_write_barrier: a call, CPUI_STORE, CPUI_CALLOTHER, or a write to persistent/address-tied storage). CPUI_LOAD is not in it. Up to the use a LOAD is a hazard this pass can decide -- the call may STORE what it reads, and the use is where the folded text lands. Past the use the reads left in the span are the ones the folded expression is printed BESIDE, inside the one statement the implied chain collapses into, so de-folding over them repositions nothing. Measured: counting them costs 117 further changed functions on the 37-binary sweep (243 instead of 126), dominated by __ctype_b_loc() inlined into the same conditional as the loads it sits next to (bash O0 0xfa64d). All 10 functions that the narrowed set still de-folds for an opcode reason were read by hand and each has a STORE emitted as its own statement in the span.
fix.exemption_self_copy: op_is_self_copy: a CPUI_COPY back into the storage its input already occupies (what RuleIndirectCollapse leaves behind) writes the value already there. Volatile excluded. Without it gh275-spillargtrial #3 and LIBCTYPES #9 each lose a fold to an artifact. Nine unit tests in kuna_callretfold/tests.rs pin the predicate directly on hand-built IR (constant-into-global and arithmetic-into-global are barriers; glob = COPY glob is not; a copy between two globals, at a different width, or of a volatile location is; an untied temporary is not; LOAD is a barrier on the first span only).
fix.exemption_chain: the ops the expression travels through are exempt from the second span test: each consumes the previous one's value, so the call is evaluated before them in the folded text exactly as in the binary. With the narrowed (writes-only) set this is no longer load-bearing: dropping it changes 0 of the 23,851 functions on the sweep. Kept for the shape it is written for -- a chain op that is itself a call with an implied output, where the folded expression is that call's own argument.
fix.not_widened: the INDIRECT test keeps the call-to-use span for the DEFAULT fold. Asking it past the use changes 31 functions across grep O0, tar O0 and ssh O2 and de-folds 27 of them, correcting none; the dominant shape is `dat_33798 = *__errno_location()` (grep O0 sub_6c53), whose binary is call/mov/mov in exactly that order. Exempting the self-copy from it as well makes kuna-elfmain's sub_1357(a1[1]) fold where it did not before -- a NEW fold, which this fix has no business adding.
fix.phi_left_alone: the span past the use is also foldcallretphi's, and an earlier revision of this branch moved that option's guard into kuna_callretfold.rs and shared it, which silently RELAXED it (the implied-chain exemption and op_is_self_copy, neither of which #654 had): with `--option foldcallretphi on`, ssh O2 0xcdd0 and dpkg O2 0x2e170 each GAINED a fold origin/main declines. kuna_foldcallretphi.rs now composes its guard exactly as it shipped -- every opcode, the storage test unsoftened, no chain exemption, the INDIRECT question over the whole distance including the landing statement -- and only print_point and the raw storage test delegate to kuna_callretfold. That guard is strictly wider than the second foldcallret span, so a phi-discounted fold is decided exactly as on origin/main. See phi_arm for the per-function content comparison that replaces the set metric.

cause_attribution.method: five builds of the second span, swept over the same 37 binaries, each changed function attributed to the clause that produced it. v1 = clause 1 only; v2 = + structural conditions; v6 = v2 but an underivable print point permitted; v3 = + the storage test; branch = + the opcodes. A function can carry two causes.

i_tied_write.what: a write to persistent or address-tied storage in the span -- the GH-657 class

ii_opcode_past_the_use.what: a call, CPUI_STORE or CPUI_CALLOTHER between the use and the landing statement
ii_opcode_past_the_use.verified: all ten read by hand: each has a STORE emitted as its own statement in the span, so each is a real textual reorder. In four of them that store writes memory the callee reads -- dash O0 0xab64 and 0xac29 put back the byte fnmatch is meant to see as a terminator; ssh O2 0x57170 folded close(fd) past `*a2 = -1`; tar O2 0x614a0 folded strlen(v11) past `*a6 = *a6 + 1`.

iii_structural.what: the folded call would be evaluated behind a branch or after a merge (so at a different time, or not at all), or the print point cannot be derived at all (a marker, a fan-out, or a chain over eight hops) and the fold declines conservatively
